map.种子发芽率与活力指数计算器 使用指南: Seed Germination Rate and Vigor Index Calculator User Guide
map.输入供试种子数及逐日发芽数，计算发芽率、发芽势、发芽指数(GI)与活力指数(VI: Enter the number of seeds tested and the daily germinated counts to compute the germination rate, germination vigour, germination index (GI) and vigour index (VI)
map.发芽率 = 发芽总数 ÷ 供试种子数 × 100%；发芽势 = 前 n 天发芽数: Germination rate = total germinated ÷ total seeds tested × 100%; germination vigour = germinated in the first n days ÷ total seeds tested × 100%; germination index GI = Σ(daily germinated count ÷ corresponding day); vigour index VI = GI × mean seedling length
map.发芽率反映最终出苗能力；发芽势取前 n 天（通常 3~4 天）累积发芽占比，反映: The germination rate reflects final emergence ability; germination vigour uses the cumulative share over the first n days (usually 3-4) and reflects how uniform and how fast germination is; the germination index GI weights each daily count by the reciprocal of the day, so earlier germination counts for more; the vigour index VI = GI × seedling length combines speed with growth quality. A germination rate >=90% is excellent, >=80% is passable, >=70% is barely usable, and anything lower fails.
map.填写「供试种子总数」。: Enter the total number of seeds tested.
map.填写「发芽势统计天数」。: Enter the number of days used for germination vigour.
map.填写「第'+i+'天发芽数」。: Enter the germinated count on day i.
map.发芽率 = 发芽种子数 / 供试种子数 × 100%。: Germination rate = germinated seeds / total seeds tested × 100%.
map.活力指数 VI = 发芽率 × 幼苗平均鲜重或苗长。: The vigour index VI = germination rate × mean fresh weight of seedlings, or × seedling length.
map.用于播前种子质量检验与播量校正。: Used for pre-sowing seed quality testing and seeding rate correction.
map.：100 粒供试 7 天发芽 92 粒，发芽率 92%。平均苗长 12 cm，活: Of 100 seeds tested, 92 germinate in 7 days, so the germination rate is 92%. With a mean seedling length of 12 cm, VI = 0.92 × 12 = 11.04. If the germination rate were only 80%, the seeding rate must be raised (÷0.80) to fill the gap.

map.发芽率和活力指数区别？: What is the difference between germination rate and vigour index?
map.发芽率只看『出不出』，活力指数还看『出的壮不壮』（苗长/重），更能预测田间出苗整: The germination rate only answers "do seeds sprout", while the vigour index also asks "how vigorous are the sprouts" (seedling length and weight), which predicts field emergence uniformity and the share of strong seedlings far better.
map.发芽率低怎么补救？: What to do when the germination rate is low?
map.提高播量按发芽率折算（目标苗数÷发芽率），或选高活力批次。低于国标良种标准的种子: Convert the target seedling count by the germination rate (target ÷ germination rate), or choose a high-vigourity batch. Seed below the national standard for certified seed should not be used in the field.
